explanation: This fires only at D1, and only when the previous trial was an a1 choice that hit the rare S2 state and paid no reward: about 3-6 if the trial before that was rewarded, and about 10 if that earlier trial was also unrewarded (often a second rare-S2 miss in a row), mostly in the second half of the episode (around trials 60-85). It is 0 at every GO and D2 step, at every D1 after a reward, and at every D1 after a no-reward that came through a common transition or an a2 choice.
